Window bay rhythm/count, pilasters, specific pointed entrance, entry side and central placement are schematic or inferred from site layout; do not treat those as verified details.

findings: The building identity and GIS-derived plan footprint are strongly supported and pass.
Do not treat 14.63 m as measured: Extrution=48 has undocumented units, and the record’s two floor-count fields conflict with the historic three-stories-plus-basement account.

The model’s exact facade, entrance placement, dormer form/count, and Tudor-Gothic detailing remain unverified because available architectural photos are Cary-complex context, not CQE-specific elevations.

Current result is below the required 8/10 threshold. Obtain CQE-specific elevations or labeled close photography, and resolve vertical/source-unit uncertainty before requesting a fresh independent grade.
